mis_014db926520a479f949359f0b15afaad.goal: Develop physical designs with the best available methods

obs_7a28c6aea5dd43c5a297eb9512701cc3.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (44df6e72511a1e03c5543d8729b722d56c551376c099f496e33ecccaadd1aa1b). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_eda2301856584c74af6a9605b62a9ebb.acceptance: A developed cart design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances. The evaluation is recorded so anyone can reproduce the comparison.
req_eda2301856584c74af6a9605b62a9ebb.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs using the externally published method retained as evidence (selection 44df6e72…aa1b), and evaluate them against the fixed cart baseline.

rsp_094411e7f22c4949ae69797d14697006.termination: A design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances, or the Lab lead closes the need
